note: _omnis populus qui habebat aliquam quaestionem_ – all the people that had any question (Douay Version). – Following the Hebrew more closely, the NVg has _omnis qui quaerebat Dominum_ – everyone who sought the Lord. – Matthew Kraus: Befragung (_quaestio_) (Ex 33,7), in: Schmid/Fieger, pp. 70–71.
_facies mea praecedet te_ – I myself (lit. “my face”) will go before you; je marcherai en personne devant toi. – Albert Blaise: _Manuel du latin chrétien_. Strasbourg 1955 (221 pp.), p. 111 (§ 167).
